confirmations.evidence: The two child pipe ends are made inheritable around CreateProcessW. LAUNCHING covers only this crate; a concurrent broad-inheritance launcher can receive them. Windows runtime was not available and later uncommitted changes were excluded.
The independent fork/upgrade harness now returns Refused for the child and exits 0.

Worker admission and inherited-descriptor tests passed
Windows policy read-backs exist; native runtime pending
Previous future-work and test-count text corrected

limitations: Only Linux runtime was executed; Windows, macOS, Android, iOS and WebAssembly remain unexecuted.
The six-target clippy matrix was not run independently because the source changed before it started; its post-snapshot formatting failure is not attributed to f3c2401.
No sanitizer, Miri, assembly, coverage, mutation or advisory campaign was repeated.
Later uncommitted Windows-worker changes require separate review and were not used to close AUD-001-SEC004.
This is not a security certification or release acceptance.
